subject: Sandbox boost request for Cloudcord POC — credit lifeline
messages:
From: Sean Peters <sean.p@cloudcord.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2024-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox access — expired credits

Hi Evelyn,

Quick one — our dev team finished an initial integration spike and we’re ready to run a broader POC next week, but our trial sandbox credits expired yesterday and the environment is locked. We don’t have a procurement PO in place yet (legal is finalizing the MSA), and the team will lose momentum if we can’t get a short window to run the load tests.

Can Redwood provide a one-time sandbox top-up or temporary reactivation (30 days) so we can complete validation? We’re targeting the week of Aug 19 for the demo to internal stakeholders. If it helps, I attached a small usage report the team generated so you can see expected token consumption.

Thanks — appreciate any flexibility.

—Sean
Sean Peters
Head of Integrations, Cloudcord
sean.p@cloudcord.io
Attachment: cloudcord_usage_report_aug.csv (CSV, 14KB)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sean Peters <sean.p@cloudcord.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2024-08-09T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox access — expired credits

Hi Sean —

Thanks for the context and the report — that helps. Short answer: we can help keep the POC moving. Proposed one-time accommodation:

- Grant a 100k-token sandbox top-up (applies to Cloudcord’s existing sandbox project)
- Valid for 30 days from issuance
- If you need longer, we’ll request a short procurement commitment/PO to extend beyond the 30 days

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm you accept the 30-day top-up and the token amount (or propose a different number).
2) Share an estimated runbook for the week of Aug 19 (rough schedule + peak seq lengths) so we check capacity.
3) If legal is near finishing the MSA, reply with expected PO timeline — I’ll route for a fast-track extension if you need extra days.

I’ve CC’d Marissa for approval on the one-time credit. If Marissa gives the green light I’ll queue the top-up and send you the confirmation + sandbox reactivation details.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2024-08-09T14:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox access — expired credits

Eve — approved. One-time 100k-token sandbox credit for Cloudcord, 30-day validity.
Conditions: require PO or signed MSA for any extension beyond the 30 days; finance to be looped if usage spikes >250% of the attached expected profile.

If you want, add a small note offering a short call with Engineering to align batch sizes and ensure they don’t hit throttling during peak runs.

—Marissa
VP, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Sean Peters <sean.p@cloudcord.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2024-08-10T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox access — expired credits

Evelyn / Marissa —

This is great, thank you both. We accept the 100k-token top-up. I’ll schedule the runbook for Aug 19 and share it by next Tue. Legal expects to return a signed MSA within two weeks; I’ll also push procurement for a PO as an insurance policy.

Please send the sandbox reactivation instructions when ready. If Engineering can spare 20 minutes to sync on best-effort batching (to avoid surprises), that would be helpful.

Attaching the current signed MSA stub for reference — legal said it’s the final version (they’ll send the fully executed copy shortly).

Thanks again — we can get the demo back on track.

—Sean
Attachment: cloudcord_signed_msa_stub.pdf (PDF, 45KB)
